title: Regulatory Compliance, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Regulatory Compliance workshop's clean entity tables on SharePoint, with a managed app. Unlisted records, rules and calculations remain in retained knowledge. Easy and Manual use the same listed fields and do not fabricate missing records.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 3 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Regulatory Compliance Executed Trade Exception S list.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including TRD-88117 (ExecutedTradeExceptionId TRD-88117), with Instrument SAP SE.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Regulatory Compliance Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 5 skills, 3 rules knowledge file(s) and 3 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Chief Compliance Officer
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Are we going to fail our next MiFID audit? What's actually broken on the desk right now?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: T-2041; T-2233. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Trading Desk Supervisor
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which of my traders can't legally trade today, and who do I have to call?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: T-2041; T-2233. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Compliance Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: We executed a few hundred trades this week. Which ones will the regulator reject, and why exactly?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: TRD-88133; field. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Head of Quant Execution
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Is anything about to go live that shouldn't?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: ALGO-POV-NL. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Chief Risk Officer
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: My head of trading says the reporting is fine. Prove him wrong with specifics I can take to the board.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: TRD-88133. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Regulatory Compliance: 3 read-only tabs from the same lists. 5 fictional records, including TRD-88117 (ExecutedTradeExceptionId TRD-88117), with Instrument SAP SE.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Regulatory Compliance Executed Trade Exception S from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload executed-trade-exception-s.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ExecutedTradeExceptionId, Instrument, ReportedVenue, Trader, ReportingEvidence, OtherEvidence to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Regulatory Compliance Executed Trade Exception S. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including TRD-88117 (ExecutedTradeExceptionId TRD-88117), with Instrument SAP SE.

steps.title: Create Regulatory Compliance Algorithm Documentation from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload algorithm-documentation.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set AlgorithmDocumentationId, StatusOnSnapshot, GoLiveState, DocumentationEvidence to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Regulatory Compliance Algorithm Documentation. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including ALGO-VWAP-EU (AlgorithmDocumentationId ALGO-VWAP-EU), with StatusOnSnapshot current.

steps.title: Create Regulatory Compliance Trader Certification Snapshot from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload trader-certification-snapshot.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set TraderCertificationSnapshotId, Desk, Certification, Status, NextSyntheticSession to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Regulatory Compliance Trader Certification Snapshot. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including T-2041 (TraderCertificationSnapshotId 1), with Desk EU Equities.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Regulatory Compliance Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Regulatory Compliance Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the three list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_fs-regulatory-compliance-rules-and-controls.md, aibast_fs-regulatory-compliance-synthetic-records.md, fs-regulatory-compliance-instruction-controls.md, and wait until ready. These generated files retain unlisted records and rules; the listed entity fields come from the list tools. Do not replace them with the original unfiltered knowledge files.
steps.expected: 3 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the executed trade exception s tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Regulatory Compliance Executed Trade Exception S; name the tool Get executed trade exception  records.
steps.expected: Get executed trade exception  records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the algorithm documentation tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Regulatory Compliance Algorithm Documentation; name the tool Get algorithm documentation records.
steps.expected: Get algorithm documentation records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the trader certification snapshot tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Regulatory Compliance Trader Certification Snapshot; name the tool Get trader certification snapshot records.
steps.expected: Get trader certification snapshot records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 5 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 5 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 5 skills, the rules knowledge and 3 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 5 skills, 3 knowledge file(s), 3 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: fs-regulatory-compliance-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 3 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Regulatory Compliance Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Regulatory Compliance Executed Trade Exception S" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Regulatory Compliance Algorithm Documentation" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Regulatory Compliance Trader Certification Snapshot" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 3 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Regulatory Compliance Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Regulatory Compliance Executed Trade Exception S tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 5 fictional records, including TRD-88117 (ExecutedTradeExceptionId TRD-88117), with Instrument SAP SE.
